args.name: Measure candidate shelter materials
args.function: Physically examine accessible loose materials or owned samples and report measured properties needed to assess the learned shelter recipe.
args.conditions: Nearby fallen branches have visible stock but observation returned no dimensions. The shelter requires 20 rigid rods of specified diameter and lengths, 30 metres of strand, and measured volumes of dry covering and bedding. No suitable material has yet been established.
args.inputs: An accessible source or owned sample selected by exact identity; any necessary measuring tools must actually be available. Methods and tool requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify realistic time, effort, tools and any sample consumption. Do not consume or reserve material without an explicit action.
args.effects: Return only properties actually measured, such as rod length and diameter, usable strand length, or mass, moisture and stem characteristics relevant to volume. Identify unmeasurable properties and unsuitable samples honestly; do not create material or imply construction.

candidates.function: Build a hand-lashed low A-frame thatched shelter for one reclining person from rods, binding, dry stems and bedding; inspect, resume, repair, dismantle or cancel it.
candidates.costs: Study 4 rounds. Every paid round is 1 energy. build: x, y in reach, orientation (open end faces local -y), materials as own items with role rod, binding, thatch or bedding; a measured shortfall is refused at no cost. Round 1 inspects site and items; a failure reserves nothing. Then 9 rounds: legs, ridge and rails, battens twice, covering four times, bedding with final inspection. build naming the shelter resumes. inspect (anyone, site or shelter): 1 round. repair: replacements for defects, a round per metre of binding or 0.05 m3 of covering or bedding. dismantle (empty): 2 rounds. cancel: free. Gathering and travel are extra.
candidates.effects: Recipe: 20 rigid wood rods (diameter 0.04 m at 0.01 m precision; legs 0.82 m, others 0.9 m long), at least 30 m of strand (vine 3 m, reed 1.8 m a unit), 0.26 m3 of dry thin-stem covering and 0.1 m3 of dry bedding, volumes from mass, water share (dry at most 0.4) and the stem law; dry grass has none. Inputs become one shelter, 1.6 x 0.8 m under a 0.6 m ridge. Complete only after the final inspection. Occupant: one body wholly on the floor that came in by the open end; a second body voids protection. Rated to rain 5 mm/h (index 1 brings 0.033 mm/h) and wind 5 m/s (index 1 read as 5 m/s): rain on the body x(1 - 0.8 x cover), wind chill x(1 - 0.5 x cover x shelter not facing the wind with its open end), dry bedding halves the ground share (0.25) of cooling; air temperature unchanged. Covering holds rain up to its dry mass, leaks through gaps, dries. Strands and covering wear 0.001 a round, 0.002 in rain or wind; below 0.75 gaps open, below 0.5 lashings fail and the frame collapses. Cancel returns unbuilt inputs once; death stops the work and drops them where the person died; built parts stay until dismantled, returned with condition and water. No reward or refund.

candidates.function: Build a small open raised rack of 2 wood supports and 3 crosspieces that holds separated whole food off the soil; load and unload it, inspect it, compare stored roots with a carried control, maintain or dismantle it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. prepare: x, y in reach, orientation; materials: exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units (first 2 supports); optional food and quantity, the proposed load. Round 1 inspects pieces and site, 1 energy; a shortfall is reported and nothing reserved. Then 3 assembly rounds, 1 energy each; prepare naming the rack resumes. load: rack, food (own stack), quantity (at most 4), controlQuantity kept carried as tracked control; 1 round, 0.5 per unit loaded. unload: 0.5 per unit. inspect (anyone) or compare (at least 5 paired rounds): 1 round, 0.5. maintain: replace (piece ids) and as many materials; 1 round, 1. dismantle (empty): 1. cancel: 0. Refusals cost nothing; an unworked round pauses free.
candidates.effects: A unit is a 0.04 x 0.99 m rod (branch). Supports lie 0.8 m apart on firm ground; crosspieces 0.08 m apart make a 0.8 x 0.2 m deck 0.08 m up, one layer of 4 units, rated twice the weakest crosspiece (37 kg each: wood strength/2, bend 0.02 half-span). Pieces become one rack; none stays loose. Loading splits the stack exactly (decay, harvest, origin kept) and lays the lot on the deck under the food water rules; rain wets it, and rain water dries off at their evaporation limit. The decay increment of whole roots there is x0.8 (declared model coefficient) only while the rack is complete and sound, the lot fits, no other material lies on it, there is no rain or standing water, it is outdoors with wind and 0.25 m clear of solids, and the lot is not wetter or warmer than its control (without one, its loading water); else x1. Compare: decay gained by lot and control, exposure, the share unequal temperature explains, verdict. Wear 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) a round; a loose crosspiece stops the rate, a loose support drops the food. No reward, refund or food.
